# Figures (generated by scripts/make_tables.py; do not edit)

Each figure exists as PNG and PDF. One line per figure:

- `frontier_SmolLM2-135M.png, frontier_SmolLM2-135M.pdf`: SmolLM2-135M: WikiText-2 perplexity against bits per weight, TCr accounting (left) and with the 1-bit mask counted (right); quantization only, best order per sparse cell, other orders in gray (11 points; data: paper/generated/fig_frontier_*_SmolLM2-135M.dat, reports/analysis/frontier_points.csv).
- `frontier_SmolLM2-360M.png, frontier_SmolLM2-360M.pdf`: SmolLM2-360M: WikiText-2 perplexity against bits per weight, TCr accounting (left) and with the 1-bit mask counted (right); quantization only, best order per sparse cell, other orders in gray (11 points; data: paper/generated/fig_frontier_*_SmolLM2-360M.dat, reports/analysis/frontier_points.csv).
- `frontier_Qwen2.5-0.5B.png, frontier_Qwen2.5-0.5B.pdf`: Qwen2.5-0.5B: WikiText-2 perplexity against bits per weight, TCr accounting (left) and with the 1-bit mask counted (right); quantization only, best order per sparse cell, other orders in gray (11 points; data: paper/generated/fig_frontier_*_Qwen2.5-0.5B.dat, reports/analysis/frontier_points.csv).
- `frontier_SmolLM2-1.7B.png, frontier_SmolLM2-1.7B.pdf`: SmolLM2-1.7B: WikiText-2 perplexity against bits per weight, TCr accounting (left) and with the 1-bit mask counted (right); quantization only, best order per sparse cell, other orders in gray (6 points; data: paper/generated/fig_frontier_*_SmolLM2-1.7B.dat, reports/analysis/frontier_points.csv).
- `frontier_Qwen2.5-1.5B.png, frontier_Qwen2.5-1.5B.pdf`: Qwen2.5-1.5B: WikiText-2 perplexity against bits per weight, TCr accounting (left) and with the 1-bit mask counted (right); quantization only, best order per sparse cell, other orders in gray (2 points; data: paper/generated/fig_frontier_*_Qwen2.5-1.5B.dat, reports/analysis/frontier_points.csv).
- `frontier_Qwen2.5-3B.png, frontier_Qwen2.5-3B.pdf`: Qwen2.5-3B: WikiText-2 perplexity against bits per weight, TCr accounting (left) and with the 1-bit mask counted (right); quantization only, best order per sparse cell, other orders in gray (0 points; data: paper/generated/fig_frontier_*_Qwen2.5-3B.dat, reports/analysis/frontier_points.csv).
- `frontier_OLMo-2-0425-1B.png, frontier_OLMo-2-0425-1B.pdf`: OLMo-2-0425-1B: WikiText-2 perplexity against bits per weight, TCr accounting (left) and with the 1-bit mask counted (right); quantization only, best order per sparse cell, other orders in gray (0 points; data: paper/generated/fig_frontier_*_OLMo-2-0425-1B.dat, reports/analysis/frontier_points.csv).
- `orders_per_cell.png, orders_per_cell.pdf`: Order comparison per cell (seed 0): WikiText-2 perplexity, KL to the dense model and pooled flips of each order relative to the best order of the cell (216 points; data: reports/analysis/q2_order_ranking.csv).
- `e2_interaction_vs_hcorr.png, e2_interaction_vs_hcorr.pdf`: E2, same Hessian per layer: each layer's P->Q interaction I_E/(E_P+E_Q) against the off-diagonal correlation index of its Hessian, by cell; Spearman rank correlation in the legend (1806 points; data: reports/analysis/e2_layers.csv, e2_spearman.csv).

Paper figures (ESANN print style, 12.2 cm wide; the PDF is in paper/generated/, the PNG here is its preview):

- `paper/generated/fig1_interaction_v2.pdf, reports/figures/fig1_interaction_v2.png`: Fig. 1 (v2, fp32, seed 0): layer-level interaction I_E/(E_P+E_Q), ratio of mean errors over layers, of the three core models in the six E1 cells (sparsity %, 4-bit | 3-bit); joint, P->Q, Q->P bars (54); white circles: the same with one shared Hessian per layer (E2, 54); negative = sub-additive. Data: reports/analysis/fig1_interaction_v2.csv.
- `paper/generated/fig_order_scale.pdf, reports/figures/fig_order_scale.png`: Order spread 100 (max - min)/min of WikiText-2 perplexity over joint, P->Q and Q->P (seed 0) against the number of compressed weights, per family (SmolLM2, Qwen2.5; 11 points), in 25%+4, 50%+4 and 50%+3; labels: model size. Data: reports/analysis/fig_order_scale.csv.
